text: My step daughter needs a dentist and she is Thai. I told her that there is no other dentist that I want her to see. I had a wisdom tooth extracted back in 2012. It bothered me for a couple of years on and off. When I moved to Pattaya in 2014, I looked for a dentist and found Dr. Tapasit. He did his magic and to this day, I have no more pain in that area. And, I had this work done in the USA. I am back home now working, but I need my step daughter to get the best care she can. There is no question she will get only the best care with this team.
After going here once, I realized I will never be going to any other dentist in Pattaya.

They are an amazing dental team, always smiling and trying their best to make things as comfortable as possible for people like me who absolutely hate the dentist.   I had a tooth pulled to get ready for an implant, went very smoothly.  My husband was told by his dentist in Canada that he needed to replace an old crown asap, Dr. Tapasit said it was fine as is, did a little filing work on the crown and it's as good as new, he is an honest and trustworthy dentist.
Excellent service and friendly staff. Very professional and explained in plain language each step of the process. Will be back for more dental work on next visit to Thailand.
World class facility and friendly staff.

Already trusting Dr Tapasit for some years for my wreck damaged teeth.
Recently had a difficult extraction to do on a molar tooth with the root only remaining to extract. Was done in less than 10 minutes without pain and difficulties though it is usually a difficult task to perform.

Special care is brought by the team to avoid the pain. Even they use local gum anesthetic before doing main injection !!

Prices are quite fair, especially for big jobs (implants, etc..) and there is no cheating : I normally had to set up 2 implants and some bone adding...but it finally ended with only one implant as the space between teeth was not enough to set up 2 implants.

Dr Tapasit speaks a perfect English, so communication is quite easy and he is really pleasant to deal with. I highly recommend Adenza dental, especially for foreigners who are usually quite demanding.

Dr. Tapasit is a professional, skilled and very personable dentist who was trained in the United States at Georgetown University. His Pattaya practice is a cut above the rest and definitely state-of-the art. Both his parents are physicians and he speaks perfect English since he was raised in the US from age 9, returning to Thailand 25 years later. While he could, no doubt, be a top tier dentist in any wealthy American city, he has (like many of us) opted for a less stressful life in Thailand where he has raised a family with his Thai wife. If you are an expat American, Aussie or Brit, Dr. Tapasit is definitely someone that you will feel comfortable with and you will likely make Dr. Tapasit your dentist, just as I have done.
